venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 11/23 (MOD MKZ; entered by MKZ; posted 12:14am ET 11/24)** Net $1,720 vs target $678 (253.7%). Food $213; no events. Comps $82.75 (4.8%) — employee discount $12, bingo credit $20, industry love $6.50, manager comp $25 (DJ tab), O4W $13.70, F&F $5.55. 52 guests; check avg $33.07. Smooth and steady Monday. About $500 of the night's sales came from a Mr Black spend. The opening shift saw more foot traffic than last week; the bar offered table service and used downtime on ABK projects to reset from the weekend. Open Deck night drew more people — the host DJ has a strong online following, and several DJs said a consistent program could build a cult following. Kitchen: BOH did a great job with a very thorough close; reviewed potato wedge portioning (each order measuring 0.6 lb) and will watch the effect on COGS over the next month. Maintenance: combi oven drainage pipe is disconnected — it runs fine during service but can't run a cleaning cycle; Rational tech expected in the next couple of days. 86 shorty service. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: chatting with first-time neighborhood guests from Decatur who are excited to come back for the meal deal.

Comps $161.25 (2.6%). 153 guests (Tock); check avg $41.07 (net / guests). Weather entered as NA. AM notes were left blank ('Loading...'). PM: 5pm and 7pm were the busiest hours, but everything ran smoothly throughout; two team members were sent off a bit early, everyone else got their hours. Kitchen: busier than a usual Monday for the two-person crew but smooth. Ended with 3 portions of rabbit and 4 Wagyu steaks left (the rest in the walk-in are the substituted beef); sold out of potatoes, hoping for more tomorrow. 911: roasted fingerlings, tart shells, burger portions. venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 11/23 (MOD Jane, Chef Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 1:58am ET 11/24)** Net $5,170 vs target $4,193 (123.3%). Food $589, beverage $4,582; no events. Comps $20.70 (0.4%). 145 guests (Sevenrooms); check avg $36. Solid build into a bumping Monday — barely ever hit a waitlist, but the room felt full most of the night, including five turns on T6. Multiple bar tabs ran well above the usual check average, including a solo guest at $153. Only two covers after midnight, as is common for early winter. 101 oysters sold (86'd around 10pm); 4 large parties, 6 solos, 143 covers per service notes. Top sellers: Rosalie, Crowd Work. Door: warm day, chilly night and a pretty busy Monday — a great flow of walk-ins from the start filled everything but the rail by 7:30pm; it thinned by 8pm but early-arriving reservations balanced the flow. A big wave of threes, fours and fives hit at 9:30pm, prompting a brief wait of about three groups. Slowed after 10:30pm; about half empty by 11pm and only 7 covers near close. Ten birthdays, a handful of solos, industry VIPs in, and Thanksgiving Day parade travelers. No no-shows. Menu count 19. Breakage: 1 coupe. Repairs: both upstairs sinks are not draining.

venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 11/23 (MOD Julian, Chefs Angel and Saleh; entered by Julian Catano; posted 3:50am ET 11/24)** Net $4,343 vs target $4,206 (103.3%). Food $1,203; Marquee $4,343 (food $1,203); Standing Room $0; no events. Comps $185 (4.3%) — DNLs, comps, discounts. 106 guests; check avg $40.97. A chill start to Oyster Monday, enough for one server to handle the floor. After dinner hours the room filled in and at one point was completely full — all hands on the floor: server, host and manager. Heavy oyster orders, with two tables back to back and two parties ordering 36 oysters each, kept the kitchen in shuck mode. Lots of new guests, a handful asking about Season's Greetings — a good opening to mention the new fall/winter cocktail line. A great Monday that hit all targets. Kitchen: a busy one on the shucking. Maintenance: oven still down (see urgent Slack). 86'd/low: Loud Silence, Hallow Technique, Contrabandista, cookies, pot de crème. No incidents; no-shows charged. Highlight: oysters flying all day.

Morning bar $780, evening bar $4,297, Sun Club and Hot Eye closed (parts sum to $5,077 vs $5,137 total entered). Food $2,191; no events; comps $192 (3.7%). Guests 162 (42 AM + 120 PM OpenTable); check avg $31.71 (net / guests). Morning: a very quiet daytime with almost no hotel guests; one food tour; staff cut as needed. Evening: off to a strong pace with a full restaurant around 5pm; everyone stayed busy through the early dinner rush and then coasted comfortably to close. No SA or barback, but the host, servers and bartenders worked well together, pitching in to run food and drinks and turn tables at the busiest point. Kitchen: no timing issues, nothing sent back or comped; 86'd sticky date cake. No events. No incidents. No maintenance needs. Highlight: lots of friends came through in the evening.

venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 11/23 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 2:39am ET 11/24)** Net $5,180 vs target $6,159 (84.1%). Food $948; no events. Comps $227.64 (4.1% as reported) — DNLs and member discounts hit hard. 112 guests (46 reservations); avg guest spend $45.44 as reported. Overcast with light showers through the day made for a mellow start, with a pop at 6pm for the dinner crowd. Management spent much of the shift on the inventory count for the month-end switch, but still took care of members. The door ran easily and flagged a reservation-system issue that has been escalated to the vendor; follow-up tomorrow. Bar ran smooth with no pressure points and the floor ran smooth as silk. Kitchen: no notes — held it down for an easy $948. No events. No maintenance needs. 86'd/low: Heart of Stone IPA, St. Germain. No incidents; no-shows charged. Highlight: multiple Mai Tais for Two going out.
